name: Automotive ADAS AEB — IPC Priority Inversion & Deadline Miss
tagline: 10 ms emergency braking deadline missed due to _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY on /dev/lidar_fusion
description: Autonomous Emergency Braking controller (adas_aeb, prio 52, 10 ms deadline) sends synchronous MsgSend requests to /dev/lidar_fusion (base prio 18). Because lidar_fusion created its channel with _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY, QNX 8.0 kernel priority inheritance is disabled, allowing medium-priority can_telemetry (prio 30) to preempt lidar_fusion for 10.4 ms and cause a 12.45 ms braking deadline miss.
